subject.title: improve(browser): batch navigation guard, snapshot delta markers, tool output schema, code-mode recipe

question: Should a navigation-aborted browser batch be represented as a normal failed batch result for compatibility, or is the new successful-results-plus-aborted-metadata contract intentionally the permanent API?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes whether later requested actions run, but current documented batch consumers are guided by per-entry failures and nonzero failure behavior rather than an aborted field.

options.title: Preserve failure semantics
options.body: Return a failing batch result or tool error when navigation aborts the tail, while keeping aborted metadata for re-snapshot guidance.

options.title: Adopt the new additive contract
options.body: Keep successful entries plus aborted metadata and explicitly version or document the required caller migration for all programmatic batch consumers.

recommendation.title: Preserve failure semantics
recommendation.body: Return a failing batch result or tool error when navigation aborts the tail, while keeping aborted metadata for re-snapshot guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this contributor most directly to the proposed Browser batch and snapshot contract changes.
